label: HSRP
notes: Cisco Hot Standby Router Protocol version 1 over UDP port 1985, sent to 224.0.0.2 with TTL 1. The 20-byte message is modelled in full: the virtual IP address is payload-embedded (a host primitive would match the routers' real addresses, not the virtual one), so it is a first-class ipv4 field. The authentication bytes carry the clear-text reused password and are modelled as two number views. HSRPv2 shares the UDP port with a different layout (millisecond timers, flags) and is not covered by this entry; VRRP and GLBP are separate protocols.

fields.label: Hellotime
fields.description: Seconds between Hello messages; the recommended default is 3.

fields.label: Holdtime
fields.description: Seconds a Hello stays valid; the recommended default is 10.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Higher value wins the election; 100 is the Cisco default.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Standby group number; the virtual MAC is 0000.0c07.acXX with XX = group.

fields.label: Authentication Data (1)
fields.description: First four bytes of the clear-text reused password; 0x63697363 for the default "cisco".

fields.label: Authentication Data (2)
fields.description: Last four bytes of the clear-text reused password; 0x6f000000 for the default "cisco".

fields.label: Virtual IP Address
fields.description: The virtual router's IP address served by the active gateway.
